review_description: I had a 13kw solar system and a Tesla charger installed by Ultimate Solar. Maisam has guide me through the process from start to finish and he manage to move forward my installation date when another client cancelled.It's been 3 months now since the installation and really happy with the performance of the system.I highly recommend recommend Ultimate Solar due to workmanship, in-house installer, competitive price and a good customer service.

Only one of the 3 suggested suppliers even contacted me (SAE). They called me once, sent me info, promised to call me back and made an appointment to do so but didn't. I went with Ultimate Solar Solutions due to a personal recommendation from a colleague at work.Chris was great. He came out to our house, spent time looking at the layout and discussed options for the installation. Explained the process and got up on our roof to measure and inspect it. He has been available to answer any questions the have arisen and has made the process smooth and easy.

These guys ticked all the boxes.  Got back to me asap, owner came to my house he was lovely to deal with and answered all my questions.  The system is high quality,  instillation was fast. The price wqs dearer than some.other quotes but was well priced for the quality system that was installed. I highly rate!

Rep from Ultimate solar solutions was very thorough & professional from the first meeting. He climbed up onto the roof and explained everything about the different systems  & their quality, performance etc. We personally researched every solar seller/installer we could find and his explainations were spot-on!We had no reservations, just paying our deposit and the rep was true to his word - keeping us informed when our system would be installed. On the day of installation it all went like clockwork - job done smoothly & efficiently - any & all questions explained clearly. All finished in a couple of hours.Very pleased with our decision and looking forward to receiving our first quarterly "bill"Thanks to Finn Peacock of "solarQuotes" for thoroughly helping us with all our research prior to purchase & to the rep at "Ultimate Solar Solutions" and his installers/elelctricians on a job well done!!And most of all - peace of mind!!

I can't comment on value for money or quality of system as I have only just had it installed but if the other parties do their job half as well then I will be a very happy man. I did get to see my meter in reverse and that was pleasing. I did have 2 systems installed and both were done in one day from 7 am until just before 5pm. No long stops good solid hard work. A pleasure to do business with them all.

The owner, who did the quote was very thorough.  It seemed like his priority was to install a quality system.  He readily answered several follow up emails and calls from us.  Installers came at appointed time and were very polite and accommodating to our questions about where cables would run.  Happy so far - it was installed 2 days ago so I can't rate the system yet!

Ultimate Solar know their products well, with lots of good information given, that was easily correlated on the internet. Able to explain differences between systems and options.Two site visits before installation.All appointments kept on time.

Very efficient was done within 2-3 hrs. Friendly and explained to us how the meter worked. Was installed within 6 weeks after signing the contract (installed on 24/3). Now will wait to see how much it will save us.
Steer clear of a compnay called Polaris Solar..very bad, put pressure on to sign and are very overpriced.
Chris was great in not only did he supply the solar panels he recommended a hot water service supplier as well and he was fantastic to.Both Chris and Brett were great.

The supplier kept me informed as to what was happening all the way - told me why certain actions were taking place and the reasons behind them - gave me a good rundown of the products used and websites were I could verify his product.
Great information from supplier before purchase, not a pushy salesperson but a real friendly *Mate* , excellent post sales follow up, will use them again for next lot of Solar Power

We are very impressed with the service, product and price we received from Ultimate Solar Solutions.  The salesman was also the installer so Chris knew what he was talking about (he was the only one that actually got up on the roof!), spent a lot of time answering all our questions and provided a very professional installation.  We are extremely happy with the end result!
The system ordered on 8 April has yet to be installed due to shortages of components such as inverter and panels.

2KW system for beach house. Conergy slow to provide components. 9KW system for home, we are STILL waiting for inverters! Installation yet to begin. Ultimate SS tell us we may have to accept 2 x 4.5kw inverters if we want job started this FY! They have been excellent both for the beach house job, and for keeping us advised on delays from Conergy, who seem to have major supply problems.

Once you have a quote for a system, ask other companies if the quoted system will do the job.See if other companies will say it is a good system or not. When we receieved our first quote we did not know anything about the different systems.We were ready to sign on the bottom line. I saw the SolarQuotes Web page and when the companies responded, I asked about the original quoted system.All of the companies said that the system we were originally quoted will not work.The inverter needed to be a dual input inverter and the quoted inverter was only a single input inverter.We avoided a costly mistake by asking around and not accepting the first quote.
Excellent service done when said it would be, honest and replaced breaker with higher rating  even when it may not have been necessary.
